feima.auth.baseUrl.markdownDescription: OAuth2 authentication server base URL (overrides region default)

feima.api.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Model inference API server base URL (overrides region default)

feima.auth.clientId.markdownDescription: OAuth2 client ID for authentication (overrides region default)

feima.promotionUrl.markdownDescription: URL for the credits promotion page (shown when balance runs out)

feima.website.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for the Feima website (used for profile and activity log links)

feima.showQuotaInStatusBar.description: Show remaining request quota in status bar

feima.warnWhenQuotaLow.description: Show warning when remaining requests drop below this number

feima.agents.codex.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `codex` binary. Leave empty to auto-discover via PATH.

feima.agents.copilot.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the GitHub Copilot CLI binary. Leave empty to auto-discover via PATH.

feima.agents.claude.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `claude` binary. Leave empty to auto-discover via PATH.

feima.agents.codex.mcpServers.markdownDescription: MCP server configuration passed to Codex. Each key is a server name; value is `{ command, args?, env?, url? }`.

feima.agents.claude.mcpServers.markdownDescription: MCP server configuration passed to Claude Code. Each key is a server name; value is `{ command, args?, env?, url? }`.

feima.agents.codex.maxApiCallsPerTurn.markdownDescription: Maximum number of model API calls Codex may make within a single turn before it's force-interrupted. Guards against a runaway loop (e.g. the model repeatedly calling tools without converging) that would otherwise never reach `turn/completed`.

enumDescriptions: Ask for approval before running commands or changing files (safe default).
Auto-approve file edits; still ask before running commands or other tools.
Auto-approve everything; never ask. Use with caution.
feima.agents.codex.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Default permission tier for @codex: how much it asks before running commands or changing files. Override for a single turn with `/ask`, `/acceptEdits` or `/fullAuto`.

feima.agents.copilot.maxApiCallsPerTurn.markdownDescription: Maximum number of model API calls the Copilot CLI may make within a single turn before it's force-aborted. Guards against a runaway loop (e.g. the model repeatedly calling tools without converging) that would otherwise never reach `session.idle`.

enumDescriptions: Ask for approval before running commands or changing files (safe default).
Auto-approve file edits; still ask before running commands or other tools.
Auto-approve everything; never ask. Use with caution.
feima.agents.copilot.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Default permission tier for @copilot-cli: how much it asks before running commands or changing files. Override for a single turn with `/ask`, `/acceptEdits` or `/fullAuto`.

feima.agents.claude.maxApiCallsPerTurn.markdownDescription: Maximum number of model round-trips the Claude Agent SDK may make within a single turn (its own `maxTurns` option). Guards against a runaway loop (e.g. the model repeatedly calling tools without converging); past this, the SDK ends the turn itself instead of running unbounded.

enumDescriptions: Ask for approval before running commands or changing files (safe default).
Auto-approve file edits; still ask before running commands or other tools.
Auto-approve everything; never ask. Use with caution.
feima.agents.claude.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Default permission tier for @claude: how much it asks before running commands or changing files. Override for a single turn with `/ask`, `/acceptEdits` or `/fullAuto`.
